plugins.Author: erdelf, Herculezz
plugins.Name: AutoDuty
plugins.Punchline: Dungeons while you sleep, eat, or work. (Swimsuit Shtola made easy.)
plugins.Description: A plugin to run dungeons for you with Trust, Duty Support, Squadrons, Variants, and Regular, Requires BossMod, vnavmesh and a Rotation Plugin (BossMod AutoRotation, Wrath or RotationSolverReborn)
plugins.Changelog:
## What's Changed
* [Crucible] Fix skipping camps when option off by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/590
* RSR IPC changed to use overrides by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/591
* (1292) Meso Terminal: b3 smoothened by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/592


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/compare/0.0.0.379...0.0.0.380
